manner of speaking, style or habit of speech, W.
customary phraseology, ib.

m: वाग्—याम mfn. = -यत, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 40, Sch.

a: वाग्य — a. [वाचं यच्छति, यम्-ड] 1 Speaking little, speaking cautiously. --2 Speaking truly. --ग्यः Modesty, humility.

m: वाग्—यम m. one who has controlled his sp˚, a sage, A.
